programme.desc: 本集融融和咪蕾来到庆州的骨窟寺体验当下韩国年轻人最喜欢的TEMPLE STAY沿着山径一步步往上岩壁与石佛静静伫立千年修行的气息在空气中流动让人不自觉放慢脚步两人更参与庙中的108拜禅武道等两天一夜活动 离开古刹后跟着咪蕾回到她熟悉的家拜访妈妈与哥哥一同制作团圆必吃的散炙还体验少见的古式汗蒸幕以柴火升温石室发汗在热气与汗水中感受最贴近土地的疗愈方式 接着来到海港向渔民购买最新鲜的生鱼片简单切盘就能吃出海水的清甜最后来到全罗北道蟾津江最有名的河螺村卷起袖子走进河边亲手抓河螺再回到厨房熬煮成暖胃的解酒汤剩下的河螺则化身为香气四溢的煎饼外酥内嫩 从山林古寺在地人家到港口与河岸这趟旅程不只是看风景更是走进韩国日常用身体与味觉细细感受生活本来的样子

programme.desc: To make ends meet and pay off her brother's mounting debts, Rana (Aylena Fusil) works daily as a roadside horror cosplayer. However, when Erza finally arrives, he completely misunderstands the situation and accuses Rana of trying to kidnap the boy. How will this misunderstanding unfold?

programme.title: Bukan Cuma Khodam, Love Tester Kita Juga Cocok

Meanwhile, Rani's grandmother, desperate to see her granddaughter find the perfect match, consults a psychic to find out what kind of man is destined for Rani. What will happen next?

programme.title: Maunya Jadian Sama Kamu Tapi Takut Dosa
programme.desc: Rosi (Rayna Snova) is the ex-girlfriend of Vino (Jeff Smith); their relationship ended abruptly because Rosi's mother accepted a bribe from Vino's mother to break them up. Fast forward to the present, Vino is working as a scare-actor in a night market's haunted house. Rosi, completely failing to recognize Vino behind the costume, ends up venting to him about how her ex cheated on her. Is there a chance for their old flame to be rekindled?

programme.title: 热辣滚烫
YOLO
programme.desc: 乐莹感到迷失和无所事事，在短暂的工作经历后，她选择退出社会。某天，经历了一连串意外事件后，她决定全新开始，拥抱生活的可能性。当她遇见一位拳击教练时，心中燃起了对新生活的希望。然而，随之而来的挑战却超出了她的想象，开启了她热血沸腾的人生旅程。

programme.title: 看我今天怎么说
Way We Talk, The
programme.desc: 这是一个关于三位年轻人探索自我的故事。子信、素恩和Alan各自面对不同形式的听障，他们通过手语建立了深厚的情谊，彼此扶持。在爱与友谊的牵引下，他们共同踏上一段寻找自我、克服挑战的成长之旅。

programme.title: 边缘行者
Man on the Edge
programme.desc: 1997年香港回归前夕，多方势力矛盾激化，黑帮暴力事件频生。巨变当前，黑帮龙头委派亲信阿骆主理毒品生意，但原来阿骆是警方的卧底。调查毒品案期间，他更揭发一场惊人的政治阴谋。

programme.title: 饭戏攻心2
Table for Six 2
programme.desc: 这是《饭戏攻心》的续集，讲述二哥和三哥在大哥离家之际，计划要结婚。最后，他们的婚宴成为一个混乱的战场，婚宴升级为家族斗兽场，造成一场喜上加喜的饭戏！

programme.title: 人约离婚后
Love is the only Answer
programme.desc: 在宝和强的婚宴上，投影机原本正播着他们相恋过程，突然画面闪出强跟性感女子的做爱片段宝冷静地走到台上宣布离婚并将婚礼实时取消，这件事迅速成为网上热话。一年来，回复单身的宝与风流快活强继续保持友好关系，一天烂滚爱玩的强竟带宝参加换妻派对，保守的宝本想离开，但遭强威迫利诱下无奈参与。在换妻派对上，两人遇上杰与妻子曼丽，四人发展出浪漫而火辣的关系...这边厢，在另一个婚宴上当投影机又是播着新郎与新娘的温馨片段时，画面又闪出意想不到...

programme.title: 峰爆
Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: 一座修建十年的隧道即将竣工之际，受地震引发连串的地裂和山泥倾泻所影响，隧道与附近的县城危在旦夕。一位退休军人和儿子俩，于绝境挺身而出，积极救援。为了守护县城16万人的安危，基建的代表人会否炸毁承载了十年心血的隧道呢?

programme.title: 西游记·女儿国
The Monkey King 3
programme.desc: 孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧一路保护师傅唐僧去西天取经，不料偶然闯进了神秘的女儿国。女儿国女皇对唐僧一见钟情，国师却下令要处死唐僧一行人。师徒四人的闯进也引来了河神现身，令女儿国陷入了危机！

programme.title: 不说话的爱
MuMu
programme.desc: 木木是一名开朗的七岁女孩，与失聪的父亲小马一同生活在聋人小区中。她是父亲与外界沟通的唯一桥梁。然而，当失散多年的母亲突然出现时，他们平静的生活被打扰，木木也被迫进入听人的世界。与此同时，小马却遭到犯罪集团的诱骗，意外卷入一个专门利用聋人从事犯罪的陷阱中。

programme.title: 手卷烟
Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: 退役华籍英军关超收留为躲避仇人的南亚裔流氓文尼。文尼身上藏有偷来的毒品，导致关超亦被黑帮追捕。两人住在同一屋檐下，纵有文化及种族的差异，但他们竟转化为相知相遇的好朋友，更成为一对忠诚的好兄弟。

programme.title: 窗前明月，咣！
Out of Order
programme.desc: 顶级律师的秘密幽会，却因酒店房间里离奇出现的一具尸体，瞬间沦为无法回头的噩梦。为了掩盖真相，他的每一步都让一切变得更加混乱。

programme.title: 拯救嫌疑人
Last Suspect
programme.desc: 女律师陈智琪在女儿被绑架后，接到神秘电话要求她为一位谋杀案嫌疑犯辩护，只有官司胜诉后才可救回女儿。陈智琪联同警员展开调查并找出证据，最终成功揭露事情的真相及幕后黑手的身份。陈智琪最后能否及时营救女儿？

programme.title: 七月返归
Back Home
programme.desc: 自幼有阴阳眼的向荣，某日收到母亲自杀不遂的消息。已移居外地的他返回香港旧居，却又看到比从前更恐怖的怪事。徘徊在人鬼当中，向荣决意要看清真相，走出恐惧的阴霾。

programme.title: 长安的荔枝
The Lychee Road
programme.desc: 一「荔」千金，盛唐爆笑开跑！小吏李善德奉命运送岭南贡果，须在荔枝变坏前的三日内，将鲜果跨越千里送达长安，只为满足贵妃一尝其鲜。沿途关卡重重、阻碍不断，在权力与荒诞交织下，这场「不可能任务」既惊险又讽刺，最终迎来一段笑泪交织的结局。

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 105
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha's lives?

programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 1
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 30
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 134
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 61
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 31
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 31
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: 利剑.玫瑰
Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. However, she shines during an unexpected operation which earns her a promotion to the acting director of the anti-trafficking team. Hua Deng Yan becomes part of the six-member anti-trafficking team that pits wit...

programme.title: 因 AI 相约
AI Romance
programme.desc: 由袁成杰、余有矿主持，心理咨询师于志凌坐镇的《因AI相约》，是中国首创全新相亲综艺。让AI红娘登场，牵起缘分的红线，用AI独家大数据模型，精准捕捉嘉宾个性，再用AI面具盲选，真诚交流点燃心动瞬间。到底是选择AI推荐，还是倾听内心声音？《因AI相约》用算法助力情缘，让爱情见证最美的邂逅！ “AI Romance” is a dating variety with a spin, marrying scientific AI technology with age-old romance and love! This is China’s first attempt at artificial intelligence experimental dating series and the programme brings on a whole new viewing experience and refreshed feel, for traditional dating varieties.

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

Bravo, My Life
programme.desc:
徐冬熙梦想成为服装设计师，一场突如其来的意外，却让她必须领养侄子成为了单亲妈妈，多亏家人及邻居协助，让她在照顾侄子之余仍得以重拾曾经放弃的梦想。姜次烈则年幼时父亲去世，其后被叔叔收养，虽曾有彷徨时期，但他头脑聪明、成绩和外貌出众，可是他做的越好，哥哥和妈妈的表情就越冷淡。为了迎合母亲的喜好，次烈无法凭自己的意愿生活，虽然不想继承家族企业却被安排进入公司工作，虽不开心但也只能等着离开这个家独立的日子…

Seo Dong-Hee comes from a poor family background but despite this, she has a bright and positive personality. She dreams of becoming a designer and slowly works her way to achieve her dream. A family accident resulted in her becoming the mother of her nephew and she decides to raise him by h...

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 嗨放派 3
Have Fun Season 3
programme.desc: 《嗨放派》是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷、自制淋浴间、起火烧饭、自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头。 “Have Fun” returns for a third season! The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed
programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. But because she was afraid to be blamed for getting drunk, to be blamed for having worn a dress, to be ...

programme.title: 翘楚
Ashes to Crown
programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径。在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军。楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政。然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火。楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患。至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运。Reborn before her fateful marriage, General's daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her family's tragic doom. She secures the throne for the young heir, earning the title of Grand Princess. When foreign forces invade, Ch...

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径。在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军。楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政。然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火。楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患。至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运。Reborn before her fateful marriage, General's daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her family's tragic doom. programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed
programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia's far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2
programme.desc: Run into a lion-hyena showdown with Julz as he hunts for the elusive Manzi pack, who are missing four of their precious pups. Then join Henry from the Zambian Carnivore Programme on a house call to the Kakumbi den, where another pup has gone AWOL.

programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkat's strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Track scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the region's species. Observe as they monitor behavior, decipher data, and deliver fascinating conclusions.

programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: 别叫我"赌神"

programme.title: 出走的决心
Like A Rolling Stone
programme.desc: 中国式好妈妈李红半生任劳任怨，在日复一日的家务与丈夫的冷漠中感到窒息。一场高中同学会意外点燃了她被埋没的青春梦想，她决定打破沉重的家庭枷锁，向妻子与母亲的身份「辞职」。李红毅然驾车出走，独自踏上重启人生的漫漫旅程，在广阔天地间寻回那个遗失已久的自我。

programme.title: 无双

programme.title: 热烈

programme.title: 秘密访客

programme.desc: 一场惨烈的校车车祸，导致几乎全部学童丧生。司机拼命救回一名男孩，却令自己失去部分记忆。男孩的父亲为答救命之恩，把司机带到自家地下室里与他们共同生活。司机渐渐发现这家人的行为诡秘，众人的异常更似乎与那场车祸有关…

programme.title: 一出好戏

programme.title: 私家侦探
Behind the Shadows

programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 2
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 31
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 135
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 62-63
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 32
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 32
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 106-107
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha's lives?

programme.title: 利剑.玫瑰
Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. However, she shines during an unexpected operation which earns her a promotion to the acting director of the anti-trafficking team. Hua Deng Yan becomes part of the six-member anti-trafficking team that pits wit...

programme.title: 嗨放派 3
Have Fun Season 3
programme.desc: 《嗨放派》是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷、自制淋浴间、起火烧饭、自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头。 “Have Fun” returns for a third season! The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 这就是街舞 6
Street Dance of China 6
programme.desc: 《这！就是街舞》再次强势回归，第六季节目迎来了常驻舞蹈导师的全新组合，包括Jay Park、Vanness 吴建豪、丁程鑫，都是非常优秀的舞者以及队长。在全新一季《这！就是街舞》中，将会有哪些街舞大神为大家带来热血炸裂的舞台？内容上不断带来惊喜外，让我们共同期待街舞引燃2023！

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径。在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军。楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政。然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火。楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患。至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运。Reborn before her fateful marriage, General's daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her family's tragic doom. She secures the throne for the young heir, earning the title of Grand Princess. When foreign forces invade, Ch...

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed
programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. But because she was afraid to be blamed for getting drunk, to be blamed for having worn a dress, to be ...

programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. She met a young dancer, Zheng Yufan, who was struggling, and devoted all her knowledge to help her win gold at an international competition. Tan Siting’s spirit of pursuing her dreams earned widespread acclai...

programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed
programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. But because she was afraid to be blamed for getting drunk, to be blamed for having worn a dress, to be ...

programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. She met a young dancer, Zheng Yufan, who was struggling, and devoted all her knowledge to help her win gold at an international competition. Tan Siting’s spirit of pursuing her dreams earned widespread acclai...

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

Perfect Match (2019)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。

programme.title: 非來不可 第2季
Fantastic Journey Season 2
programme.desc: 孟非、劉震雲決心效仿中國最早的自由行「西遊」，攜何廣智、李雅娟升級為「非震式旅行社」；邀請尹正、哈妮克孜、武藝、張雨綺、楊迪、楊超越等飛行嘉賓，先後到達喀什，塔什庫爾干，獨庫公路，烏茲別克斯坦等地，串聯起雪山草原、戈壁大漠、城市綠洲，開啟一場前所未有的奇遇之旅。

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: 姐姐當家
Her Prime
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣。

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
A Wonderful Life Starts with Health
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

programme.title: 音你而來 第3季
The Melody of You Season 3
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: 黑月光法則 (短劇)
Princess Revenge (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: 國醫少年志 第2季
Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 2
programme.desc: 由徐璐、夏之光、高瀚宇、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，通過年輕化視角拆解中醫奧秘，讓中醫藥文化穿越千年時光，讓更多的年輕人讀懂中醫、愛上中醫，看見傳統醫學在現代生活中的蓬勃生命力。

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季
Love Actually Season 4 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 30+的素人嘉賓們帶著成熟與期待，在摩登都市上海入住郊區小屋，從陌生到熟悉，從心動到堅定，共同開啟一段30天的尋愛之旅；除了元老嘉賓謝楠、張純燁、唐藝昕之外，更邀請了徐藝洋和顏安等組成「半熟觀察員」，一同見證高甜瞬間。

programme.title: 音你而來 第3季
The Melody of You Season 3
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: 黑月光法則 (短劇)
Princess Revenge (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: 超燃青春的合唱
Voices of Youth
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程。

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2021) (S12)
Perfect Match (2021)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季
Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.desc: To make ends meet and pay off her brother's mounting debts, Rana (Aylena Fusil) works daily as a roadside horror cosplayer. One day, she comes across Erza's (El Ryan Carlen) young nephew and decides to bring him home since Erza hasn't shown up to pick him up yet. However, when Erza finally arrives, he completely misunderstands the situation and accuses Rana of trying to kidnap the boy. How will this misunderstanding unfold?

programme.title: Bukan Cuma Khodam, Love Tester Kita Juga Cocok
programme.desc: Rani (Aylena Fusil) goes to the market to buy coconut milk from Aris (Masaji Wijayanto). Due to a classic misunderstanding, Aris thinks Rani hasn't paid yet and goes chasing after her to demand the money. Meanwhile, Rani's grandmother, desperate to see her granddaughter find the perfect match, consults a psychic to find out what kind of man is destined for Rani. What will happen next?

programme.title: Aura 34 Babe Angels Bikin Hati Semrawut
programme.desc: Mayang (Emilia Samma) takes the initiative to hire Juleha (Larasati Nugroho) as a personal bodyguard for Kevin (Mahdy Reza) after he gets jumped by a group of men. However, Kevin rejects the idea out of hand. He is convinced that having Juleha as his bodyguard will only make his life miserable—plus, in his eyes, a woman being a bodyguard is just downright impossible. How will this unlikely duo get along?

programme.title: 前任4: 英年早婚
The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: 孟云和余飞这对难兄难弟已届适婚年龄，二人在爱情路上都遭遇挑战。孟云经历分手后被家人催婚，而余飞和女友为应对婚后挑战，创立了「结婚冷静期」以应付可能出现的问题.

programme.title: 焚城
Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: 因非法偷运废料引发的一场大火，香港陷入辐射泄漏危机。为了应对这场毁灭性的灾难，专家范伟立加入由署理行政长官领导的紧急应变小组。一支消防队伍临危受命，深入辐射区，拼尽全力阻止辐射扩散。在面对前所未见的浩劫时，他们能否拯救这座城市？

programme.title: 热血合唱团
Find Your Voice
programme.desc: 「热血合唱团试验计划」打算特训由三流学校学生组成的古典音乐合唱团去参加「校际合唱团比赛」。外界对这次计划一致不看好，但美国著名华裔指挥家严梓朗，消声匿迹一年后竟答应来港担任合唱团指挥。「热血合唱团」与严指挥最终能否排除万难，完成这个不可能的任务？

programme.title: 谋杀似水年华
Kill Time
programme.desc: 小麦为找逝去父亲喜爱的一首歌曲，意外遇到一家网店「魔女区」。在此奇怪的网店，客人只可限购一次，小麦却禁不住再买一条紫色的围巾。这条围巾不但令她回忆起逝去的父亲以及初恋，更可能与一宗离奇谋杀案有着千丝万缕的关联。

programme.title: 久别重逢
Last Song For You
programme.desc: 那年盛夏，少女夏文萱和少年苏升华因一张唱片相遇相恋，当时他们最想知道这清涩的爱情能走多远。转眼数十年，音乐人苏升华在医院意外重逢初恋夏文萱，两人都身处人生低谷。夏文萱病重，看穿苏升华的内心挣扎，决定送他一段最后的旅程，希望能重燃他对生命的热情与希望。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传：侠之大者
Legends of the Condor Heroes: The Gallants
programme.desc: 在成吉思汗及其继承者的统领下，蒙古铁骑横扫四方，先灭金朝，后将南宋视为下一目标。值此武林各派内部纷争四起之际，郭靖与黄蓉携手团结中原武林英杰，共同守卫襄阳，展现了为国奋战的无畏勇气与坚定忠诚。

programme.title: 白昼如焚
As It Burns
programme.desc: 探员魏允调查言贞在爆炸中死亡的案件，看似平凡的意外，魏允却认为疑点重重。直至他看见言贞儿时好友卢子峰的女友林音长得跟言贞十分相像，魏允随即发现连串扑朔迷离的关系，并合过去及现在的案情细节后，真相更是出人意表。

programme.title: 搜救
Come Back Home
programme.desc: 寒冬季节，阿德一家自驾游到长白山旅行，途中却因走失其八岁儿子而乐极生悲。阿德向当地派出所求助，可惜孩子仍未找到。即使黄金救援时间已过去，阿德和救援队伍仍坚持继续搜救任务。最后又能否顺利拯救儿子？

programme.title: 长安的荔枝
The Lychee Road
programme.desc: 一「荔」千金，盛唐爆笑开跑！小吏李善德奉命运送岭南贡果，须在荔枝变坏前的三日内，将鲜果跨越千里送达长安，只为满足贵妃一尝其鲜。沿途关卡重重、阻碍不断，在权力与荒诞交织下，这场「不可能任务」既惊险又讽刺，最终迎来一段笑泪交织的结局。

programme.title: 饭戏攻心
Table for Six
programme.desc: 本喜剧的三兄弟同住在已故父母所留给他们的屋檐下。大哥坚持每晚都要一家人一起吃饭，而当他们开始邀请各自的女朋友同住时，关系也变得非常紧张，从而引发出爱情与友情的矛盾和妒忌，及各种错综复杂的感情问题。六位主角将一同饭戏攻心！

programme.title: 流浪地球2
The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: 此前传描述太阳即将毁灭，人类在地球表面建造出巨大的推进器，寻找新的家园。然而宇宙之路危机四伏，为了拯救地球，流浪地球时代的年轻人再次挺身而出，展开争分夺秒的生死之战。

Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 32
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 136
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 64
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 33
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 33
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 利剑.玫瑰
Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. However, she shines during an unexpected operation which earns her a promotion to the acting director of the anti-trafficking team. Hua Deng Yan becomes part of the six-member anti-trafficking team that pits wit...

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.desc: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkat's strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Track scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the region's species. Observe as they monitor behavior, decipher data, and deliver fascinating conclusions.

programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 4
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 33
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 137
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 65-66
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 34
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 34
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 110
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha's lives?

In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.desc:
徐冬熙梦想成为服装设计师，一场突如其来的意外，却让她必须领养侄子成为了单亲妈妈，多亏家人及邻居协助，让她在照顾侄子之余仍得以重拾曾经放弃的梦想。姜次烈则年幼时父亲去世，其后被叔叔收养，虽曾有彷徨时期，但他头脑聪明、成绩和外貌出众，可是他做的越好，哥哥和妈妈的表情就越冷淡。为了迎合母亲的喜好，次烈无法凭自己的意愿生活，虽然不想继承家族企业却被安排进入公司工作，虽不开心但也只能等着离开这个家独立的日子…

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 乡野有真味第三季
Country Roads Delicious Food S3
programme.desc: 《乡野有真味第三季》将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落——广东、广西、浙江、福建、湖南、江西、安徽、贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧、古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的“暗黑”美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码。“Country Roads Delicious Food S3” turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. Venturing deep into bamboo groves, mountain streams and narrow lanes of ancient villages, the series explores “obscure” delicacies and novel flavours that challenge our taste buds, unveiling the culinary secrets wo...

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 年少有为
No Pain No Gain
programme.desc: 打工人裴谦惨遭辞退后，意外获得神秘大佬的邀请，需创办一家必须以亏损为目标的公司。于是他故意集齐各种虾兵蟹将、给员工加薪发福利，也投资了各种奇葩项目。不料竟一次次意外反转，成为了业界的商业奇才、员工心中的良心老板。有苦难言的裴谦不得不带领公司继续逆风翻盘，终成当地第一集团。Salaryman Qian is laid off but unexpectedly receives an offer from a mysterious tycoon to found a company that must operate at a loss. He deliberately hires incompetent employees, offer them unimaginable raises and benefits while also investing in bizarre projects. Surprisingly, all his ventures turn out to be successful. programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. She met a young dancer, Zheng Yufan, who was struggling, and devoted all her knowledge to help her win gold at an international competition. Tan Siting’s spirit of pursuing her dreams earned widespread acclai...

Perfect Match (2019)

programme.title: 職來職往2026
Job Match 2026
programme.desc: 打破傳統求職單向選擇的邏輯，從企業「滅燈挑錯」的評判模式，升級為發掘求職者自身閃光點的賦能模式。企業面試官可以隨時爆燈拋出橄欖枝，同步明確崗位與薪酬待遇，大幅拓寬求職者的選擇空間，讓雙向匹配更高效、更真誠。

programme.title: 姐姐當家
Her Prime
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣。

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季
Love Actually Season 4 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 30+的素人嘉賓們帶著成熟與期待，在摩登都市上海入住郊區小屋，從陌生到熟悉，從心動到堅定，共同開啟一段30天的尋愛之旅；除了元老嘉賓謝楠、張純燁、唐藝昕之外，更邀請了徐藝洋和顏安等組成「半熟觀察員」，一同見證高甜瞬間。

programme.title: 王牌對王牌 第八季
Aces vs Aces Season 8 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂！

programme.title: 百姓的味道
People's Palate

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

However, Halda harbors a sinister motive: she plans to set up a fake mother in order to scheme her way into the inheritance left by Jirayut's late father, which was promised to anyone who could reunite them.

programme.desc: Fikri is a Manusia Silver (a silver-painted street performer) who falls head over heels for Bulan, a beautiful municipal police (Satpol PP) officer. Could Yudha just be a figment of Saskia's imagination,...

In a fit of pure panic, Echa and El mistake the knocked-out Tristan for dead. A stressed-out Echa wants to report it to the police, but El argues that no one will believe Tristan's death was just an accident. To avoid prison, El suggests dumping the "body," and a reluctant Echa agrees. Just as they are about to dispose ...

programme.desc: Vino haunts a beautiful girl he is targeting every day. It is said that Vino was a victim of a romantic conflict that led to his death. Strangely, Vino suddenly appears wearing a dragon club jacket, scaring the girl. However, as the story progresses, Vino continues to help her find safety and security. Until one day, the girl is hospitalized, and her best friend and mother tell her that she has been hallucinating about the existence of Vino, the guy who has been helping her all this time.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir and Sukma are a simple yet happily married couple. Their happiness is tested when their child, Zahra, is diagnosed with a serious illness amidst their financial struggles. At the same time, Fathir unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend, Clara, whose presence changes everything.

programme.title: Di Depan Dukung, Di Belakang Nikung
programme.desc: Riska (Rina Diana), who has run away from home, is hit by a minibus driver named Arya (Vicky Nitinegoro). Upon arriving at Arya's house, Riska looks for an excuse to stay there.

programme.title: Leio / Leio
programme.desc: 一名过气歌手回乡奔丧并顺道参加一场钻井大赛，除了拯救家乡干旱的土地，更希望赢得百万现金大奖。但他和其他参赛者都不知道，在这片干涸的土地下，竟潜藏着凶猛无比的致命巨兽，准备将人类生吞活剥！

programme.title: 曾经拥有
Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: 港产片影痴吴少金患有阿兹海默症，依靠弟弟撑起两人合办的电器维修店。节目监制细姜对吴少金的古灵精怪行为感到好奇，怀疑他可能是个以尖酸刻薄的影评谋利的影评人。于是，细姜假扮朋友接近吴少金和他的家人，却渐渐发现他的秘密和辛酸故事。

programme.title: 恶战
Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
programme.desc: 二十世纪初，各地劳动人口纷纷涌入高速发展之上海。山东青年马永贞(伍允龙 饰)亦到上海当码头工人。当时上海各帮派荼毒社会，其中较有正义感之龙七(安志杰 饰) 赏识马永贞胆识过人、武技非凡。二人惺惺相惜，成为好友。龙七反对贩毒及向日军卖力，与斧头帮三大犯罪头子白癞痢(陈观泰 饰)、笑面佛(袁祥仁 饰)、仇老四(冯克安 饰)为敌，马永贞与他连手反毒，令三人怀恨于心。马永贞与江湖卖艺的铁师父(洪金宝 饰)及其两个女儿铁梅(蒋璐霞 饰)、铁菊(胡然 饰)成为邻居。马永贞被铁菊的硬朗性格所吸引，而铁菊亦佩服马永贞的正义感，对他渐渐产生好感。龙七则迷恋上歌女盛香君(毛俊杰 饰)，没想到日后竟因此而身陷险境。斧头帮因不满龙七的嚣张跋扈，与日本间谍桥本密谋除掉他，龙七惨遭暗算。马永贞的邻居亦遭受袭击，马永贞赶至时已尸横遍野，垂死的铁师傅告知铁菊被斧头帮掳走。极度悲痛的马永贞为救铁菊，单人匹马闯入斧头帮老巢，决定用双手消灭国家的敌人、社会的败类，为民除害!

programme.title: 捣破法兰克
Smashing Frank
programme.desc: 四名戴着兔子面具的年轻劫匪策划了针对上流社会的抢劫行动。他们自称「Frank」，目的不是为了金钱，而是透过涂鸦和疯传影片揭露贪污的真相。当他们与一个涉及洗黑钱的强大教会组织发生冲突时，行动迅速演变成一场致命的博弈。

programme.title: 我老婆系赌圣
My Wife is a Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: 一次偶然的机会，阿轮在沙滩救了患上失忆症的盈盈，并招呼她回家中居住。盈盈不单美丽性感，还身手了得，帮助阿轮收坏胀，把欺负他的女友打走。盈盈心算比计算器还要快，且赌术精湛，麻雀、赌波、赛马，她无一不精通。阿轮深深的爱上了盈盈，向她求婚，可惜在婚礼举行前夕，盈盈突然失踪。当阿轮找到她时，原来她已在参加亚洲赌王大赛，对手是无恶不作的赌场大鳄仇曼联，她还有一个未婚夫亨利。阿轮呆住了：难道这一趟他又好梦成空？

programme.title: 不是你不爱你
Love at First Lie
programme.desc: 那年暑假，性格开朗善良的平凡少女阿宝偶遇不务正业的富家子家伟。为报复父亲再婚，家伟聘用阿宝及其好友等人捣乱婚礼，促成他与阿宝认识并开始交往。两人情投意合，尝尽热恋甜蜜，岂料命运却为这段爱情安排了急转直下的暗涌…

programme.title: 猎狐行动
Fox Hunt
programme.desc: 本片改编自真实案件。诈骗犯戴逸宸骗取大量民众血汗钱后神秘失踪，七年潜逃海外后，终在法国巴黎现身。中国侦缉探员叶钧率领猎狐小队跨国追赃，却在行动中揭开惊人秘密。

programme.title: 死尸死时四十四
Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: 这部黑色喜剧始于一具来历不明的尸体被发现在一个住宅单位门前，同层的四家人担心尸体会令居所变成凶宅，使楼价大跌，从而卷入了将尸体运走的大混乱中。

programme.title: 迷城
Wild City
programme.desc: 天民原本是一名警察，后来转行经营酒吧。一天深夜，正当他准备关门时，遇见了一位醉酒女子，却因此招惹上她的前任情人及其手下的追杀。随着天民的弟弟和一箱现金卷入其中，这场致命的追逐变得愈发危险。

programme.title: 哥，你好
Give Me Five
programme.desc: 无所事事的小伍与患上脑退化症的爸爸相依为命，而爸爸只剩下和妻子有关的零碎记忆。为替父亲寻回失去的回忆，小伍阴差阳错穿越时空回到过去，却意外破坏了父母的过去遭遇。小伍要使父母二人复合，否则他不会出生在这世上。

programme.title: 金手指
The Goldfinger
programme.desc: 电影取材自80年代香港最大宗的财经丑闻，讲述程一言由一个寂寂无名的小喽啰一跃而成为亿万富豪，并担任上市公司主席的故事。然而，当程一言的财富疯狂飙升，势力日益壮大时，廉署高级调查主任刘启源决定介入调查，即使花了长达15年时间，也誓要找出真相。

programme.title: 夺冠
Leap
programme.desc: 2008年北京奥运会，昔日中国女排传奇郎平竟以美国队主教练身份击败中国队，深陷舆论漩涡。多年后，当中国女排陷入低谷之际，她毅然回归，执教新一代女排新力军。她以铁腕改革打破常规，带领球员们绝地突围，最终在2016年里约奥运上演惊天逆袭，重夺奥运金牌。

programme.title: 老狐狸
Old Fox
programme.desc: 1989年，年轻的廖杰和他的父亲为购房而存钱，却不知道房价正在飙升。饱受贫困之苦，他向房东老狐狸学会在社会中求生存。廖杰最终以所学伤害了老狐狸，但他的同情心终究使他没有成为另一个老狐狸。

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 67
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 35
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 35
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 112
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 6
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 乡野有真味第三季
Country Roads Delicious Food S3
programme.desc: 《乡野有真味第三季》将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落——广东、广西、浙江、福建、湖南、江西、安徽、贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧、古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的“暗黑”美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码。“Country Roads Delicious Food S3” turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 烈焰
Burning Flames
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: 好事成双
Alliance
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human world.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome sisters Xiba, Xyla, and Xola, a trio of starving orphans who turn Winston's world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. Then monitor new cubs Yasmine and Yara, who get reacquainted after a stressful separation.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2
programme.desc: Head back to the den with the Kakumbi, who are mourning the loss of two pups. Chance upon a hyena den and a lion pride trying to take down a buffalo, then catch up with the Manzi, who are in a standoff with a leopard and a herd of angry elephants.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets Season 2
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America's largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: South Africa's Drakensberg is one of the continent's most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in s...

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the course of South Africa's Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies; this is the story of the Linear Oasis. We reveal how life is adapted to survive along its course and discover a rich world of plants and animals.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti Season 1
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long'uro and see why six-year-old Kelele's mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti Season 1
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world's largest land mammal.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands' massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom's most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Gladiators Season 1
programme.desc: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badger's risky dance with a deadly snake.

programme.title: Gladiators Season 1
programme.desc: Go up against Australia's wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroo's deadly boxing moves and the redback spider's precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators Season 1
programme.desc: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands' massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉在调查非法足球搏彩集团时目击嫌疑犯被杀。重案组督察刘保强急需陆志廉的口供，但因廉署的保密守则，陆志廉无法提供任何线索，阻碍刘保强的调查。二人由调查开始时的互不信任，到最后发展出默契，誓要将犯罪集团连根拔起。

programme.title: BBS乡民的正义
Silent Code
programme.desc: 记者蓝苡晴授命在网络上找新闻，意外闯入超红的BBS网络论坛。李澄湘是创立梦想板的板主，原意是让网友们分享彼此的梦想，却因为一段不该外流的影片而成为人肉搜索的主角。苡晴一路追查下去，发现事实的真相越来越复杂…

programme.title: 我爱你!
Love Never Ends
programme.desc: 空巢老人和拾荒的孤寡老太不打不相识，却渐渐互生情愫；另一对年迈的夫妻俩靠收卖废品为生，妻子却深受疾病的困扰。两对老年爱人深爱着对方，哪怕不再有明天，也要对彼此说出「我爱你！」。

programme.title: 长江七号
CJ7
programme.desc: 周星驰强势回归的作品，讲述一对父子在垃圾桶里发现可爱外星人后，出现一连串既搞笑又温馨的故事。

programme.title: 镖人: 风起大漠
Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: 隋乱将至，逃犯镖客刀马受命护送神秘人，自西域大漠远赴长安。不料护送对象竟是「天字第一号逃犯」，引发各方势力围追堵截，荒漠沙海间厮杀不断。随着阴谋逐渐浮出水面，刀马被卷入一场牵动天下的朝廷与江湖博弈，在危机四伏的长安路上，展开一场生死难测的血战。

programme.title: 一样的天空
Look Up
programme.desc: 此片是庆祝香港回归25周年的献礼电影，描述四位不同背景年青港人的故事，包括一名自闭症的青年追寻艺术梦、父子两代矛盾如何和好、粤剧名伶突破自己协助年轻人发展流行音乐事业、一名尼泊尔青年成为醒狮队员的文化共融故事。

programme.title: 无间一战
Endless Battle
programme.desc: 故事围绕着一对兄弟。弟弟是贩毒集团的头目，哥哥健忠则是缉毒组探员，二人不约而同卷入一场毒枭的地盘斗争中。一次，健忠在押送毒贩的过程中无意间发现弟弟隐藏着的真正身份。一场无间反转的正邪交锋随即展开。

programme.title: 命中注定那头鹅
Penguin Girl
programme.desc: 月鹅钟爱阿德利企鹅，也深信真爱该如企鹅伴侣那般纯粹。当身穿企鹅装的何德利出现在她眼前时，她不禁思索，这是否就是命运安排的另一半。随着两人对未来的憧憬渐生迷惘，他们是否仍能如企鹅般成为忠诚的眷属？

programme.title: 红豆
Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: 张家经营着位于九龙城的中式甜品店，然而母亲突发中风，令一家人陷入剧变。女儿为了维持甜品店的生意，不得不放弃成为空姐的梦想，却在过程中与父亲产生冲突。他们一家能否齐心协力，克服重重难关？

programme.title: 浴火之路
Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: 三位因孩子被拐而痛失半条命的绝望家长，在寻亲路上满腔怒火地结成生死同盟。面对穷凶极恶，丧尽天良的跨国拐卖犯罪集团，他们彻底抛开一切顾忌，深入大西北荒漠展开一场以暴制暴的血性搏杀。他们究竟能否击碎黑暗贩卖网，活着把孩子带回家？

programme.title: 猎金游戏
A Gilded Game
programme.desc: 野心勃勃的金融高材生高寒，适逢好友的家族企业正筹备在香港上市，因而被引荐进入投行实习。在首席分析师张托德的带领下，高迅速崭露头角，却因野心作祟而背叛恩师，转投竞争对手。当好友的家族企业被敌意收购时，为了弥补过失，高恳求张相助，连手阻止这场恶意收购。

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 35

programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 36
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 36
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 焦急的恋爱
My Military Valentine
programme.desc: 南北韩停战宣言后的未来，为实现南北统一而在DMZ建设的试点智慧城市和平市。作为韩国顶流偶像的劳埃德在和平市结束庆祝汇演后，在进行罕见军械装备交易时，遇到当时执行炸弹搜索任务的朝鲜特种兵英玉，被她误认为是恐怖分子。更糟糕的是，在那一瞬间有记者们还拍下了照片，劳埃德陷入了丑闻之中，对英玉的第一印象可谓强烈。为了躲避丑闻而入伍的劳埃德，在部队与教官英玉再次见面。某天，完成反恐训练从训练场返回生活馆的途中，劳埃德从行军队伍中掉队，迷路彷徨之时遇到被反统一极右派团体 “紫罗兰” 追赶的自己的超级粉丝韩松伊。

One City One Taste Xi An
programme.desc: 《一城一味·长安有滋味》将以西安为核心，辐射咸阳、宝鸡、榆林、汉中等地，从地域美食、风土人情等方面切入，通过一个个鲜活生动的故事，以小见大，多方位记录和展现一座城的多维之味，让观众品尝到陕西人的热度与温度。

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 《全城地图：最强明星队》是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝、红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗。该节目以“将城市化为竞技场”为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀。The Best Team” is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 烈焰
Burning Flames
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: 好事成双
Alliance
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 春色寄情人
Will Love In Spring
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 桃花映江山
The Princess' Gambit
programme.desc: 《桃花映江山》讲述了祁国左相沈在野因一次政敌处心积虑的陷害，与北苑国和亲公主姜桃花相识，一个腹黑狠辣，一个狡猾伶俐，在波谲云诡的两朝时局之下，二人斗智斗勇、互相算计，在面对强敌的被迫合作中又暗生情愫，在面对国家与爱情的选择，他们突破重重阻碍，共谋定江山……。The drama tells the story of a fallen princess forced into a political marriage with a corrupt prime minister. She faces numerous dangers but strives to survive to protect herself amidst the conflicts of national loyalty, personal vengeance, and true love. Meanwhile, the prime minister, outwardly ambitious to become a treacherous official, secretly harbours a desire...

programme.title: 凡人修仙传
The Immortal Ascension
programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事。Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. Through his own hard work and perseverance, he overcomes strong and intense competition between immortal practitioners and finally attains immortal cultivation, becoming the proud conqueror of the three worlds!
